snapshot.text: Health system reformed since 2017 around the National Health Service of Ukraine as single purchaser, now operating under full-scale war. WHO has verified more than 3,000 attacks on health care since the invasion; recovery and resilience frame policy.

priorities.title: Health system strategy to 2030
priorities.text: The ministry reports annual results against its health system development strategy to 2030.

priorities.title: Protecting frontline healthcare
priorities.text: Underground hospital wings, modular primary care clinics and winter preparation of facilities in frontline regions.

priorities.title: Medical evacuation model
priorities.text: At WHA79 Ukraine presented an integrated medical evacuation model from the battlefield to rehabilitation.
